subject: truck2077
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: futuristic militarized truck from 2077.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk, extremely intricate.
reasoning:
I'm planning a self-contained TypeScript module for a rigged armored truck: chassis root, multiple wheel joints, a turret with yaw/pitch controls, keeping the structure compact at around 400 lines with my own helper functions since I can't use external samplers.

I'm working out the wheel geometry and axle placement, then the chassis and joint hierarchy, choosing hinge roles for the wheels and planning to reuse the panelled/metal paint kits for the gunmetal body with hazard stripe decals and HUD-style textures.

Now I'm sketching out the overall build plan: cab nose with sloped glowing windshield, ribbed cargo box, roof turret with railgun and missile pods, lighting and neon details, spiked bumper, exhaust stacks, and 12-lug wheels with neon rim rings. I'm laying out the coordinate scheme for the hull width, chassis height, and three wheel axles front to back.

Still laying out the vehicle geometry...

Checking wheel geometry so the tread sits flush with the floor, then planning paint colors within the material limit and decal planes mapped to the correct side normals so text reads correctly from outside. Now setting up a helper function for building parts.

Writing part helper...
